short.q: Describe the steps for learning to write a new letter. (4 marks)
short.answer: Trace the model; copy it several times from right to left; write it from memory and compare; add and check the dots.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: List the six Arabic letters that do not join to the letter that follows them. (3 marks)
short.answer: alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw.
short.working: 3 marks for all six; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

short.q: Name three verbal cues and say how each one helps the listener. (3 marks)
short.answer: Intonation shows questions and statements; speed shows importance or excitement; tonal variation shows feeling.
short.working: 1 mark for each cue with its use.

short.q: Translate into English: raʾsii kabiir
short.answer: My head is big.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: anaa tilmiidh
short.answer: I am a pupil (boy).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Name two common foods in your area and write one Arabic sentence about one of them, with its meaning. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example maize and bananas. al-mawzu ladhiidh. The banana is delicious.
short.working: 1 mark for two foods, 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for its meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ʿiid mubaarak
short.answer: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhihi ghurfatii
short.answer: This is my room.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Explain how to build a vocabulary bank for the theme of the body. (3 marks)
short.answer: Write each new word with its sound and meaning, add a small drawing, and keep the words on cards or a page for practice.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid step.

short.q: Translate into English: al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila
short.answer: The lamp is above the table.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: hadiyya li-Aminata
short.answer: A gift for Amina.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-baytu kabiir
short.answer: The house is big.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: List four characteristics of good handwriting. (4 marks)
short.answer: Correct letter shapes; letters the same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; even spacing; clean page.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid characteristic, up to 4.

short.q: Give three tips that help a speaker to use tone and pace well. (3 marks)
short.answer: Speak loudly enough and clearly; speak at a steady speed; pause between sentences; smile when greeting.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid tip.

short.q: Translate into English: maa ismuki?
short.answer: What is your name? (to a girl)
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: al-mawzu ladhiidh
short.answer: The banana is delicious.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three differences between the Arabic and the English alphabets. (3 marks)
short.answer: Arabic is read from right to left; it has no capital letters; letters join and change shape; it uses marks for short vowels; it has sounds like ʿayn and Haa that English does not have.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid difference, up to 3.

short.q: Translate into English: al-maa'u nadhiif
short.answer: The water is clean.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: an-naafidhatu nadhiifa
short.answer: The window is clean.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin
short.answer: Do not play with the knife.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhaa abii
short.answer: This is my father.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: uhibbu T-taʿaam
short.answer: I like food.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i wal-ghaymu fii s-samaa'i. (2 marks)
short.answer: The sun is in the sky and the clouds are in the sky.
short.working: 1 mark for each half.

short.q: Translate into English: aakulu l-khubza
short.answer: I eat bread.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Rearrange the words to make a sentence and translate it: الْخَمِيسِ / يَوْمُ / الْيَوْمُ. (3 marks)
short.answer: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ. Today is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Translate into English: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir
short.answer: The cat is under the bed.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe two ways in which your class can look after the school environment. (3 marks)
short.answer: Plant and water trees; put rubbish in bins; keep water clean; sweep the compound.
short.working: 1 mark for each way and 1 mark for a reason.

short.q: Describe how to make a vocabulary bank of words about the home. (3 marks)
short.answer: Write each Arabic word on a card with a picture; write the sound and meaning on the back; keep the cards in a box or on a chart and use them to practise.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid step.

short.q: Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii
short.answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: haadhihi ummii
short.answer: This is my mother.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write three body parts in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example raʾs (head), yad (hand), fam (mouth).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Explain how a spelling bee is played. (3 marks)
short.answer: Teams take turns; a learner says the Arabic word and spells it by naming the letters; correct spelling earns a point.
short.working: 1 mark for teams, 1 mark for spelling by letter names and 1 mark for scoring.

short.q: Translate into English: fawqa t-taawilati baaluun
short.answer: Above the table there is a balloon.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write four parts of the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example raʾs (head), ʿayn (eye), fam (mouth), yad (hand).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Write the Arabic greeting for 'peace be upon you' in English letters and give the reply. (2 marks)
short.answer: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. The reply is wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam.
short.working: 1 mark for the greeting and 1 mark for the correct reply.

short.q: Write an Arabic question and its answer that you could use to find out who a woman in a photograph is. Use English letters. (3 marks)
short.answer: man haadhihi? haadhihi ummii. (Who is this? This is my mother.)
short.working: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer, 1 mark for correct use of haadhihi for a woman.

short.q: Copy and translate the sentence أُحِبُّ الْخُبْزَ. (2 marks)
short.answer: uhibbu l-khubza. I like bread.
short.working: 1 mark for a correct copy or sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'Today is Thursday.' (2 marks)
short.answer: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis. Today is Thursday.
short.working: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Give three ways in which a family can reduce food wastage at home. (3 marks)
short.answer: Cook only what is needed; store leftovers and eat them later; share extra food; use peels for compost.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible way.

short.q: Write one Arabic sentence about a household item using a describing word, and translate it. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example al-baabu kabiir. The door is big.
short.working: 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for a matching describing word and 1 mark for the translation.

short.q: Translate into English: jismii qawiyy
short.answer: My body is strong.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Describe how to draw and label a household item. (4 marks)
short.answer: Draw the item, colour it, write its Arabic name under it from right to left, write the meaning and check the spelling.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Look at a picture of a birthday party with a cake with a candle and friends standing round the table. Make a prediction and give a reason. (2 marks)
short.answer: The friends will sing and eat the cake, because the cake has a candle and they stand round the table.
short.working: 1 mark for a sensible prediction and 1 mark for a reason from the picture.

short.q: Translate: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir. al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila. (2 marks)
short.answer: The cat is under the bed. The lamp is above the table.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence.

short.q: Translate into English: as-samaku ladhiidh
short.answer: The fish is delicious.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Give three rules for a handwriting contest. (3 marks)
short.answer: Everyone writes the same words for the same time; judges look at shape, size, spacing and neatness; everyone is encouraged and praised.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible rule.

short.q: Translate into English: aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad
short.answer: I read a book on Sunday.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Put these syllables in order to make a family word and give its meaning: khaa + lun. (2 marks)
short.answer: khaa-lun (mother's brother).
short.working: 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: ismii Ahmad
short.answer: My name is Ahmad.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr
short.answer: May you be well every year.
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Name four key words about the home in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

short.q: Translate into English: jaddii kabiir
short.answer: My grandfather is old (big in age).
short.working: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

short.q: Write four lines of a short conversation in which two friends greet each other and ask names. Use English letters for the Arabic. (4 marks)
short.answer: For example: A: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. B: wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam. A: maa ismuka? B: ismii Ahmad.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct line: greeting, reply, question, answer.

short.q: Write three Arabic questions about a picture of a party and give their meanings. (3 marks)
short.answer: For example ayna l-kaʿka? (Where is the cake?) man haadhaa? (Who is this?) maadhaa fawqa t-taawila? (What is above the table?)
short.working: 1 mark for each correct question with meaning.
